adaptations.name: Prismhide
adaptations.description: Crystalline skin reduces damage and refracts light. +2 armor.

adaptations.name: Sunveins
adaptations.description: Store light charge in your veins. +2 attack damage.

adaptations.name: Mirage Step
adaptations.description: Leave a decoy at your previous position when you move. Enemies attack the decoy first.

adaptations.name: Saltblood
adaptations.description: Immune to glass terrain damage. Glass tiles restore 1 HP per step instead of dealing damage.

adaptations.name: Storm Drinker
adaptations.description: Storms energize rather than hinder you. +2 AP per turn during storms. Refraction gain from storms doubled.

adaptations.name: Killing Edge
adaptations.description: Melee attacks deal +3 damage. After killing an enemy, your next attack this turn costs 0 AP.

adaptations.name: Lens Eye
adaptations.description: FOV range +4. Ranged attacks never miss targets within 6 tiles.

adaptations.name: Salt Sense
adaptations.description: Loot containers are highlighted in FOV. Crafting recipes require 1 fewer ingredient (minimum 1).

adaptations.name: Scar Lattice
adaptations.description: Each time you take damage, gain 1 temporary armor (stacks up to 5, resets each combat).

adaptations.name: Bone Spur
adaptations.description: Melee attacks have a 20% chance to cause bleed (3 damage/turn for 3 turns). Bleed stacks.
